commits.message:
refactor(render): the draw's output is a Frame, and every byte derives from it (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.abb) (#550)

* test(render): every terminal lane's bytes, pinned before the draw keeps its structure (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.abb)

Committed against unchanged source, so the snapshot is evidence the change
moves no byte: the ANSI and the band and tmux status lanes, at all four depths,
menus closed and open, from the bundled default and a config using the supported
API's reach, plus a RENDER_FAILED response through both lanes. The reach is
asserted, so a config that stops drawing a blank row, a wrapped row, a ColorBlend,
a moving effect or a fade fails.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(render): the draw's output is a Frame, and every byte derives from it (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.abb)

draw() held rich-js segments and threw them away, so a bar existed only as
bytes. It now returns lines of runs in the colours drawn at the frame's depth;
drawDsl stamps each line's kind into a Row and DrawnFrame holds the Frame.
encodeAnsi is the one path from a draw to bytes. Callers holding no Frame hand
it their depth, and strip geometry reads plainOf without encoding.

No byte moves: test/frame-bytes.test.ts.snap and the default menu snapshot are
untouched. Readers move off the bytes in later tickets.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(render): encodeAnsi writes what rich-js writes, and is the one path to bytes (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.abb)

Compares encodeAnsi over runLines with segmentsToString at all four depths, over
a grid of named, indexed, hex, translucent and blended colours and over every
loop effect at advancing times, and asserts its own reach. Asserts a run's colours
were drawn, not copied from the spec, and that src holds no second path to bytes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(render): a strip that draws no line stays loud, and runLines takes only the depth it reads (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.abb)

A row vanished silently when rich-js drew no line, where the earlier check threw, so the check returns over lines and carries the single-enforcer marker it lost. runLines took a whole Destination and read one field, so a caller's hyperlinks or reducedMotion were ignored here and honoured nowhere; it takes the depth. Two comments overclaimed: a truecolor run can hold a standard colour's name, and bytes outside a draw are hand-written today.

* perf(render): a run's attributes read one list of names, not a new object per run (candybar-isolated-daemon-bfab.abb)

style.attributes builds a 13-entry object on each read, only so its keys could name attributes that never change. On a 200-run row that was 0.136 ms against 0.02 ms, about a third of the encoder's added cost on an effect's hot path. The list is derived from rich-js once, so it holds no state and restates nothing.

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

gitaculous already shows the location, so the default layout drops directory

The default identity row and five bundled presets (compact, verbose, zen,
git, dense) still placed `directory` beside `gitaculous`, which now draws
the checkout path itself. Every default user saw the path twice. The
directory segment stays defined in the library; only its placement goes.

Tests that read the bundled layout now name a segment the bar still places,
and the doc fence shows the one path it renders.

Known consequence: `zen` now holds only `context`, so it no longer shows
where you are. Its comment still describes the old intent.
feat(site): the live bar's font size is a slider
feat(site): the live bar's font size is a control, and starts larger
feat(site): site:dev serves the live bar and reloads it on every rebuild
